description: This file is a PHP class definition for managing themes within the OpenCart admin module. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, and fetch theme data from the database.
external_files: database connection and query execution via `$this->db`

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents the model for managing themes in the OpenCart admin module, providing functions to manipulate theme data in the database.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme record into the database with data provided in an array.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme record identified by theme_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Deletes a theme record from the database by theme_id.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a theme record from the database by theme_id.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Fetches a list of themes from the database with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of themes in the database.
